name: How long does a molding repair project typically take?

mainEntity.name: How long does a molding repair project typically take?

acceptedAnswer.text: Most straightforward molding repairs take between two and four hours for a single room, while multi-room projects or custom profile replacements may take one to two days. Simple jobs involve removing damaged sections, securing new pieces, filling nail holes, and applying caulk. The overall timeline extends when materials require custom milling, extensive drywall repair behind the trim, or multiple paint coats that need adequate drying time between applications. Having replacement profiles on hand beforehand helps keep the schedule short.
acceptedAnswer.description: A single-room trim repair usually takes 2 to 4 hours, while multi-room repairs or custom milled installations can take one to two days including drying and paint time.
